narrative.northStar: Boletín Oficial de Federación en Cancha
narrative.overview: LolonmeApp treats an amateur friends' football league with the structural authority of a South American football federation matchday dossier grounded on the pitch. Rather than floating shadowed SaaS cards on generic gray backgrounds, the interface rests on crisp technical ivory paper divided by 1px architectural hairlines, anchored by a committed Federation Pitch Green shell with subtle chalk-line geometry and Tournament Gold trims.
keyCharacteristics: Committed Federation Pitch Green (#0a4a28) header and matchday strips with subtle white chalk-line geometry (.pitch-chalk-surface).
Flat, crisp 1px structural hairlines (#d6d3c7) on technical ivory paper (#f6f5f0) instead of blurred drop shadows.
Leather Orange (#c86e0e / #e68e23, sampled from the official Logo.svg ball) reserved for active selection, focus rings, and season toggles.
Condensed tabular dorsal typography (Barlow Condensed) paired with a clean workhorse UI sans (Archivo).

rules.name: The Flat Dossier Rule
rules.body: Depth is communicated through 1px architectural hairlines (#d6d3c7) and subtle tonal shifts (#f6f5f0 paper vs. #ffffff surface vs. #0a4a28 committed shell), never blurred drop shadows or glassmorphism.

dos: Do use Logo.svg for header/small icons and reserve LogoLOLONMEBOL.svg for large display contexts where the wordmark is legible.
Do format all dates and currencies through formatDateEs, formatMonthKeyEs, and formatArs in src/lib/utils.ts.
Do keep form inputs at 16px (text-base) on mobile and touch targets at >= 40px.
donts: Don't place eyebrows or kicker labels above headings.
Don't nest bordered cards inside other cards or reintroduce generic KPI metric tile grids.
Don't use mowed-grass stripes, neon glows, gradient text, or border-l-4 bars on rounded containers.
